speaker: Doctor
text: I see you are presenting with fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. These symptoms suggest a systemic process. To narrow this down, have you experienced any recent fevers or changes in your appetite?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: I'm concerned about the combination of weight loss, night sweats, and supraclavicular lymphadenopathy; have you noticed any skin rashes, easy bruising, or bleeding gums recently? Please also tell me if you have a history of alcohol use or any chronic illnesses.

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The "fixed" nature of the supraclavicular lymph node is highly concerning for malignancy. Have you experienced any painless lumps in your armpits or groin, or any difficulty swallowing?

REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential, LDH, and ESR.
REQUEST IMAGES: Ultrasound of the neck and abdomen.

Biopsy: Cervical Lymph Node - Lymphocytes with a high proliferative index, CD20 positive.
